title: Ruck Over The Ball (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the ruck is the breakdown war
First arrival wins it, second arrival saves it
Get over the ball, drive through the gate

[Verse 1]
Arrive low, hands on the ground past the ball
Feet wide, shoulder width and a half, stand tall
Drive the opposition past the ball with the chest
Clear the threat, son, leave the ball at rest

[Pre-Chorus]
Enter through the gate, never from the side
Gate is the back of the tackled player, the divide
Bind on a teammate or the carrier, never solo
Latch and drive, son, the ruck flow

[Chorus]
Ruck over the ball, son
First on the scene, the work begun
Drive through the gate, low and hard
Past the ball two metres, raise your guard

[Verse 2]
Body position low, eyes up looking forward
Hips below shoulders, legs pumping toward
Drive with the legs, not the arms
Leg drive wins rucks, son, leg drive charms

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, three seconds at the ruck
That is all you have, then the ref says truck
Quick ball wins games, son, slow ball loses
Get to the ruck fast, dont confuse it

[Chorus]
Ruck over the ball, son
First on the scene, the work begun
Drive through the gate, low and hard
Past the ball two metres, raise your guard

[Outro]
First arrival, low body
Gate is the back, the rule embodied
Leg drive past the ball
Thats my boy, dont stall
